properties.description: The deprecating half of dec:anchor-retire-or-implement, checked the way a client of the MCP server sees it, with deprecation::REGISTRY as built (its first real entry) and every call over the protocol: (1) describe_schema marks Anchor `deprecated` with the registry's what-to-do, lists it under `deprecations` with the decision and 0.85.0, the listed item is the registry's item and not marked as vocabulary, Anchor is the only marked type, and the what-to-do names tools this build serves (add_epoch, snapshot_before_change); (2) create_node of an Anchor still works and answers exactly as the last release did but for `deprecation_notice`, and get_node and scan_nodes of it carry the notice; (3) DriftEvent's hint no longer names the Anchor and says it DEPENDS_ON the drifted Artifact, a recorded reconcile_artifacts draws exactly that edge, and Anchor's hint no longer claims DriftEvents reference it; (4) nine common reads that never touch Anchor carry no notice.
properties.findings: SUPERSEDED 2026-10-17: the Anchor type it checked the announcement of was removed in 0.86.0, and its test file was deleted; ver:the-unused-anchor-type-is-removed checks the removal. Its last run (2026-10-14, 4/4 passing on 81c5f2a1a) stands as the record of the deprecating release.
properties.name: The unused Anchor type is announced for removal
